تعترفن (form VIII)

# تُعْتَرَفْنَ (tuʕtarafna) /tuʕ.ta.raf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
